changes: Bind public upstream Token, TokenSink and State types, replace private ASCII helper locally.
Double the reserved transport escape only for decoded character-reference output.
Preserve upstream tokenizer tests and licenses.
Remove redundant condition parentheses so compiler warnings remain clean under CI RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings.

Drop the exact_errors, discard_bom and profile options (and the profiling timers): the native adapter never enables them, so only the inexact error messages, BOM-preserving input and unprofiled run loop remain.
Replace the per-architecture SSE2/NEON data-state fast path (and its scalar fallback compiled on neither) with one portable byte scan producing the same chunks and line counts.

Carry no code the native adapter provably never runs: peek/discard_char reconsume branches (no peek-based state is a reconsume target), the unquoted-attribute-value slow-path FromSet arm, the EOF arm of markup-declaration-open (eat never suspends at EOF), the char-ref EOF retry loop and the NumericSemicolon Stuck arm; impossible states are unreachable!().
